title: Illustration / Too much color
slide_intent: Limit competing hues because small illustrations need clear parts and a readable silhouette.
strategic_value: A restrained palette can keep Duolingo icons legible at reduced sizes.
demonstration: A green frog and three green swatches contrast with a crossed-out frog and five varied swatches.
practical_value: Reduce unnecessary hue changes and check the result at the intended display size.

content_islands.name: Restrained palette
content_islands.spec: Keep the green frog and its three swatches together at left.

content_islands.name: Rejected palette
content_islands.spec: Place the more varied frog and five swatches inside the pink rejection frame beside it.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says too many colors can hurt legibility when an object scales down.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Keep an illustration to a few colors; no fixed maximum is stated.

ingredient.name: Illustration color count
ingredient.application: Use a few colors and remove changes that reduce legibility at small sizes.
ingredient.scope: Three versus five swatches illustrate this frog comparison, not a universal three-color maximum.
